messages:
Ivy: Heads-up — MercuryPay POC goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. They want a concise handoff: reserved GPU count, AZ split, autoscale behavior for 2-7m spikes, preheat expectations, and a clear note on quantized runtime licensing.
Malik: Traffic sketch?
Ivy: SRE sent: steady 210 qps embeddings + 70 qps generations, daily short spikes to ~1.3k qps lasting 2-7m. 95p targets: embeddings <=130ms, gen <=240ms. Business-hours SLA weekdays.
Priya: Quick sizing thought: reserve for steady + 20% headroom -> round to 4 reserved A100-eq GPUs. Autoscale up to 8 with burst credits for spikes.
Malik: They asked for AZ spread. Best practice: symmetric 2+2 for true failover. If budget limited, 3+1 is acceptable but document degraded tail during failover.
Ivy: Can we paste a short preheat runbook they can use and sign?
Priya: Short preheat runbook (copyable):
1) Schedule preheat 30m before expected peak.
2) Run KV replay at ~30% expected peak for 5 mins.
3) Run synthetic QPS soak at 50% for 5 mins.
4) Verify KV hit-rate >= 85%. If check fails, enable burst credits and notify Redwood oncall.
Malik: Autoscale policy snippet for ops (pasteable):
```json
{ "autoscale": { "min_reserved_gpus": 4, "max_gpus": 8, "scale_step": 1, "cooldown_s": 180, "preheat_window_mins": 30, "burst_credit_pool": "enabled", "burst_qps_cap": 1800 }}
```
Priya: Note: cooldown tuned to 3 minutes to avoid oscillation on 2-7m spikes. Set per-customer burst cap so one tenant can't exhaust shared pool.
Ivy: Legal/License question: quantized runtime fee?
LegalBot: Quantized runtime is provided under the platform infrastructure fee. We'll add explicit contract language: "Redwood's quantized inference runtime is included in platform services; no separate runtime license applies."
Malik: Pricing ask: they want a blended quote (reserved monthly commit + burst credits). Presales guidance: reserved = monthly commit rate; burst credits sold as hour-blocks at incremental rate; cross-AZ reserved adds +5% infra surcharge. I'll add numbers to the one-pager.
Ivy: Observability checklist we need to include for their security form: per-route token counts, 95/99/99.9 latency percentiles, KV hit-rate, preheat job status, audit trail for preheat triggers. Exposed in Console + API; metrics aggregated with PII filtered.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC — schedule preheat outside this window. :warning:
Ivy: We'll move preheat earlier. Action items: (1) I will draft a one-page: sizing rationale, AZ split, autoscale snippet, preheat runbook, pricing bullets, licensing line (2) Malik to add pricing numbers (3) Priya to add KV warmup script and small k6 sample (4) LegalBot to confirm contract line. Aim to send to MercuryPay within 3 hours.
Priya: I'll drop the minimal KV warmup script and k6 snippet into the packet.
Malik: I'll prepare two price options: 4-reserved (2+2) symmetric and 4-reserved (3+1) budget with degraded failover note.
Ivy: Thanks all — I'll assemble and post for review before sending. :rocket:
